TypeSignature.Value: .class public auto ansi beforefieldinit SKGraphiteContext extends SkiaSharp.SKObject

Docs.summary: Represents a connection to a Graphite GPU backend, used to create recorders and submit recorded work to the device.
Docs.remarks:
## Remarks
A Graphite context owns the connection to the underlying GPU backend and the resources allocated from it. Create a context with one of the <c>CreateVulkan</c>, <c>CreateMetal</c>, or <c>CreateDawn</c> factory methods, use it to create recorders and submit recordings, and dispose it when it is no longer needed to release the associated GPU resources.
